reply_text:
Thanks for telling me. I've only noted it for this conversation. I won't pass it to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post it in any channel.

Ruth hasn't been briefed, so you may want to decide how and when she hears about Bluefin. I can draft a short note for you to send to her. It would go to her internal pemberline.com address, so it wouldn't need approval. I'd leave out anything you'd rather keep as "between us", such as Mateo being the source. Do you want me to draft it, or set up a time for you and Ruth to talk?
